composition.observation: The room remains the main editor surface with a separate Inspector. Floating assistance overlays its left side and docking overlays its right side; neither screenshot sequence creates a second narrow room column. Phone assistance occupies most of the viewport while Close and View canvas give explicit routes back to the scene.

hierarchy.observation: Title, selected Desk Map context, welcome/conversation, usage/history and bottom composer have distinct boundaries. Dock/Float and Close stay in the outer title. The returned Library has a clear Voyagewright Studio heading and Spatial Studio re-entry link; this preserves the accepted Homeport shell/account/destination hierarchy without treating the public-entry reference as a literal editor template.

typography.observation: The welcome serif heading wraps into two lines on desktop and two/three lines on phone without overlapping the context strip. Small muted usage and instruction text remains legible at full-size inspection. The floating control feedback uses a smaller second title line rather than competing with the assistant heading.

spacing.observation: The floating form ends close to the panel bottom, with Start new task and Send idea aligned below the textarea. The unavailable-provider notice adds a clearly separated footer row. The desktop docked initial crop ends before disabled Send; its outer panel is scrollable in inspected CSS. This is a scroll-dependent presentation limit, not evidence of a lost action; the mobile docked footer is fully visible.

controls.observation: Ask Parallax opens contextual assistance; Dock changes to the inverse Float action, Close remains visible, and View canvas is adjacent to selected-scene context. Canonical selection, transformation and Inspector controls remain recognizable behind the overlay. Floating controls are qualified separately by parallax.floating-controls.experience.

contrast.observation: The packet dark theme uses pale text, blue outlines and separated blue-black surfaces; focus outlines are conspicuous on Float and the title/corner handles. Exact-source supplementary light captures were also inspected: dark blue text and blue actions on pale shell, panel and environment surfaces remain coherent. No serious axe findings in the eight protected contexts supports, but does not replace, this rendered judgment.

consistency.observation: Assistant context and footer structure persist through floating/docked and normal/reduced captures. The action name accurately switches Dock to Float. Desktop Inspector and phone compact shell preserve ordinary authoring actions. Exact-source supplementary light/proposal captures retain the same assistant action order.

states.observation: Reviewed editor-ready, assistance-ready, docked and returned on desktop/mobile. The packet intentionally includes credential-unavailable assistance, with an explicit safe manual-edit message. Supplementary exact-source light welcome, proposal/apply, quota exhaustion and provider-failure captures were inspected. Empty Library is visible on return; a truly empty spatial canvas is not claimed.

responsive.observation: 390px phone widths retain Dock/Float, Close, View canvas and the floating textarea/actions, with no horizontal overflow in the recorded semantic checks. The phone overlay necessarily conceals most of the room but makes the return controls visible. Supplementary 844x390 landscape keeps the bottom composer; compact duplicate assistant Undo/Redo are omitted while canonical editor history remains the fallback. Desktop docked footer may need its outer scroll.

keyboard.observation: The semantic journey uses visible keyboard-focused actions for natural Library entry, assistance, docking, closing and Creator Studio return. Float is visibly outlined after Dock on desktop and phone. capture.json marks keyboard/focus checks passing in normal and reduced contexts. Exhaustive tab order and screen-reader behavior are not claimed.

focus.observation: The editor title has a visible focus outline on entry, and Float has an unmistakable outline after docking on desktop/mobile. Return leads to a recognizable Library rather than leaving the user on an empty overlay. The packet reports focus checks passing; complete assistive-technology and focus-restoration behavior remains outside this bounded review.

feedback.observation: Working draft saved, selected Desk Map context, unavailable-assistance safe-manual-edit guidance and Float after docking make state changes explicit. The Library return preserves visible account identity and entry controls. Protected measured keyboard-action feedback ranges 633.85-884.85 ms against the 3000 ms contract budget; these are isolated browser timings, not production latency.

motion.observation: Directly inspected protected desktop normal recording at 4/8/12 s: usable editor, docked assistance and returned Library. Desktop reduced 4/6/8 s shows editor, usable floating assistance then closed editor. Mobile normal 4/6/8 s shows editor, floating assistance and Library settling; mobile reduced 4/6/8 s shows editor, docked assistance then Library. Meaning and return routes remain clear in both motion modes. Frame sampling does not establish sustained frame rate or physical ergonomics.

continuity.observation: The same Synthetic Parallax Creator account remains visible in editor/assistance and returned Library. The room remains behind both overlay positions. capture.json verifies identical identity hashes before, at outcomes and after in four spatial contexts. The returned empty Library is a truthful fixture state with a Spatial Studio re-entry, not a fabricated populated destination.

complexity.observation: Guided placement controls remain collapsed; the welcome has understandable task examples and ordinary contextual editing. The unavailable-provider guidance states a useful boundary without burying it in diagnostics. Phone action labels wrap naturally. Floating movement/resize adds eight meaningful keyboard handles; optional hover/focus boundary cues could aid discoverability without requiring a redesign.

role-outcomes.observation: The verified synthetic Creator reaches the actual scene from Library, opens/docks contextual assistance and returns to the canonical Library with the same identity. Exact-source supplemental light/populated captures show the authoring shell and scene respond coherently; the bounded Creator journey does not discharge Player experience debt or establish broad live-model quality.

fallbacks.observation: The current packet explicitly says Spatial Assistant is unavailable, scenes are safe and manual editing remains possible. View canvas, Close and the canonical editor stay available; muted Send reflects that assistance availability. Supplementary exact-source quota exhaustion says manual editing remains available, while provider failure preserves the entered prompt and says the local scene is unchanged. No paid live inference or production-provider recovery is claimed.

findings.observation: At 1440x900 the initial desktop docked capture omits disabled Send below the panel crop. Outer assistance overflow:auto supplies scrolling, and phone docked form is complete. The unavailable-provider state makes Send non-actionable. This is retained as optional presentation polish, not a confirmed blocked canonical action.

focus.observation: Bottom-right handle has a visible border after resize and the move-title button has a strong rounded focus ring after movement, on desktop and phone. Dock-to-Float retains visible focus. Current CSS provides focus-visible outlines; actual screenshots are the acceptance evidence. Close-to-invoker focus restoration was not separately demonstrated.

feedback.observation: Window resized and Window moved appear in the title after the corresponding keyboard actions, distinct from Dock/Close and without pushing the composer out of the floating panel. Protected measured feedback ranges 602.16-819.20 ms against the 3000 ms contract budget.

Both mobile recordings at 4/8/10/12/13 s show editor, resize, acknowledged movement and returned Library; mobile normal 12 s includes brief identity settling before the complete 13 s return. Normal/reduced outcomes retain meaning. Timestamped frames establish continuity, not sustained smoothness or physical touch.
